items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I did a gig with Tiny Grimes that got televised

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean you know, playing with big people, you know, like 280 pounds or something. Never mind, sorry, bad joke.

Well that’s tough. I remember one time in Boston when I was going to school I did a gig with Tiny Grimes that got televised, and that was funny, because a friend of mine broke a table laughing so hard when he watched it at home.
